John — thanks, noted. Looping in Aditya (Sales Engineering) and Dev (Security) to provide the infra/KMS details and the full subprocessors export.

Quick answers while they put together docs: 
- Cloud providers: primary production runs on AWS (us-east-1) with optional GCP backups for some customers; we do not provisionally share plaintext customer data with external model-training vendors.
- Model training: Redwood does not re-train base models on customer-provided production data by default. We keep customer content isolated; any training on customer data is opt-in and contractually scoped.
- BAA/HIPAA: we can sign a BAA for Private or Dedicated deployments. For Hosted customers handling PHI, we recommend Private/Dedicated and will work with legal on controls.

Aditya/Dev — could you add the infra diagram, KMS/HSM notes, and the subprocessors CSV to this thread? Also call out any subprocessors that have broad access to customer content vs. metadata-only.

Hi John / Sofia — thanks for the follow-ups. Attaching our subprocessors export and an infra diagram for your review (see attachments). Key items below: 

1) Subprocessors (attached CSV: redwood_subprocessors_2026-10-07.csv) — short list highlights: 
   - Amazon Web Services (AWS) — core compute, S3 object storage (may store encrypted customer artifacts). Has access to infrastructure-level logs; customer content is encrypted at rest using customer or Redwood-managed KMS depending on plan.
   - Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — optional embeddings/data pipelines for customers who request it (region-limited).
   - Datadog — monitoring & metrics (no access to plaintext customer prompts or completions).
   - Sentry — error diagnostics (scrubbed context; we avoid full content in error logs).
   - Postgres managed provider — metadata store for routing & telemetry (metadata only).

2) Data access & training: We do not use customer production content to train or fine-tune models unless explicitly contracted and opt-in. All such work is governed by a separate MSA addendum and reviewed by privacy.

3) KMS/HSM & encryption: 
   - We support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / Cloud HSM) for encryption at rest. For Dedicated/Private deployments, customers can bring their own keys (BYOK).
   - In Hosted mode we offer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys for customers with strong residency or key control needs.

4) HIPAA / BAA: 
   - Redwood can execute a BAA for Dedicated or Private deployments. For Hosted we evaluate on a case-by-case basis and recommend Private for PHI workloads.

5) Data residency & isolation: 
   - Region pinning available for Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted customers can choose regional endpoints where available.

6) Next steps we recommend: 
   - Review attached CSV and infra diagram. If legal/procurement wants, we can schedule a 30-minute call with our security team (Dev + Security PM) this week to walk through any redlines.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to walk through any specific items.

--
Dev Patel
